$comment: The catalogs motionhub sorts its motions into, by the form of film each is made for (HUB.md, "Catalogs"). The home page shows them in this order, each motion in its catalog's order; a motion may be in several, or in none until a maintainer sorts it.

catalogs.name: Explainers
catalogs.line: How something works and why, drawn as it is explained.

catalogs.name: Data stories
catalogs.line: Numbers, comparisons and places, told so they land.

catalogs.name: Stories
catalogs.line: A narrative told through people, places and time.

catalogs.name: Tutorials
catalogs.line: Step by step: how to make, set up or learn something.

catalogs.name: Breakdowns
catalogs.line: A claim, a document or an event taken apart and checked.

catalogs.name: Over your footage
catalogs.line: Drawn over a video you bring: a person speaking, a screen recording.
